# Project Instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository. It is the source of truth for the architecture, migration goals, and platform constraints.

The workflows under `.gemini/skills/` and `.gemini/rules/` are reference material. Use their role definitions and process guidance when relevant, but do not assume that Gemini- or OMX-specific commands and tools are available in GitHub Copilot.
